policy.workflow: word + POS + current Chinese meaning -> original sentence + zh-Hant-TW translation -> basic quality check

a.en: A good question can lead to a much deeper discussion.
a.zh: 一個好問題可以引導出更深入的討論。

a.m..en: The school library opens at nine a.m. on weekdays.
a.m..zh: 學校圖書館平日上午九點開門。

abandon.en: The hikers had to abandon their plan because of the storm.
abandon.zh: 登山客因為暴風雨而不得不放棄原本的計畫。

abbreviate.en: Writers often abbreviate long terms after introducing them clearly.
abbreviate.zh: 作者在清楚介紹長術語後，常會使用縮寫。

abide.en: All students must abide by the rules of the laboratory.
abide.zh: 所有學生都必須遵守實驗室規則。

ability.en: Practice can improve your ability to understand difficult reading passages.
ability.zh: 練習可以提升你理解困難閱讀文章的能力。

able.en: She was able to finish the report before the deadline.
able.zh: 她能夠在截止期限前完成報告。

abnormal.en: The doctor noticed an abnormal pattern in the test results.
abnormal.zh: 醫師注意到檢查結果中有異常的模式。

aboard.en: Everyone was safely aboard the train before it left the station.
aboard.zh: 火車離站前，每個人都已安全上車。

abolish.en: The school decided to abolish a rule that was no longer useful.
abolish.zh: 學校決定廢除一項已不再實用的規定。

aboriginal.en: The museum introduced aboriginal art from several regions of Taiwan.
aboriginal.zh: 博物館介紹了來自台灣數個地區的原住民藝術。

abortion.en: The textbook discussed abortion as a complex social and medical issue.
abortion.zh: 課本將墮胎作為一項複雜的社會與醫療議題來討論。

abound.en: Wildflowers abound in the valley during the warm spring months.
abound.zh: 溫暖的春季裡，山谷中遍布野花。

about.en: The class watched a short film about ocean pollution.
about.zh: 全班看了一部關於海洋污染的短片。

above.en: The temperature stayed above thirty degrees throughout the afternoon.
above.zh: 整個下午氣溫都維持在三十度以上。

abroad.en: She hopes to study abroad after graduating from high school.
abroad.zh: 她希望高中畢業後到國外留學。

abrupt.en: An abrupt change in weather forced us to return early.
abrupt.zh: 天氣突然改變，迫使我們提早返回。

absence.en: His absence from class made the group presentation more difficult.
absence.zh: 他的缺席讓小組報告變得更困難。

absent.en: Two students were absent because they were attending a competition.
absent.zh: 兩名學生因參加比賽而缺席。

absolute.en: There is no absolute answer to every question in social science.
absolute.zh: 社會科學中的每個問題都不一定有絕對答案。

absorb.en: Dark materials absorb more heat from sunlight than light materials.
absorb.zh: 深色材料比淺色材料吸收更多陽光的熱能。

abstract.en: The teacher used a diagram to explain an abstract idea.
abstract.zh: 老師用圖表來解釋一個抽象概念。

abstraction.en: The painting uses abstraction rather than realistic detail to express emotion.
abstraction.zh: 這幅畫以抽象手法而非寫實細節來表達情感。

absurd.en: It would be absurd to ignore all the evidence we collected.
absurd.zh: 忽略我們收集到的所有證據是很荒謬的。

abundance.en: The region is known for its abundance of fresh fruit.
abundance.zh: 這個地區以盛產新鮮水果聞名。

abundant.en: Clean water is abundant in some places but scarce in others.
abundant.zh: 乾淨的水在某些地方很充足，在其他地方卻很稀少。

abuse.en: The campaign teaches students how to recognize and report online abuse.
abuse.zh: 這項活動教導學生如何辨識並通報網路上的不當侵害。

academic.en: She received academic support when she struggled with mathematics.
academic.zh: 她在數學遇到困難時獲得了學業上的協助。

academy.en: He joined a summer academy that focused on science and engineering.
academy.zh: 他參加了一個以科學與工程為主的暑期學院課程。

accelerate.en: New technology can accelerate the process of collecting research data.
accelerate.zh: 新科技可以加快蒐集研究資料的過程。

accent.en: Her English accent changed slightly after living overseas for years.
accent.zh: 她在海外生活多年後，英語口音有些改變。

accept.en: We should accept useful feedback and learn from our mistakes.
accept.zh: 我們應該接受有用的回饋並從錯誤中學習。

acceptable.en: The teacher explained what level of evidence was acceptable for the report.
acceptable.zh: 老師說明了報告可接受的證據標準。

acceptance.en: The new policy gained wide acceptance among students and teachers.
acceptance.zh: 這項新政策獲得學生與教師的廣泛接受。

access.en: Students can access the online library with their school accounts.
access.zh: 學生可以使用學校帳號進入線上圖書館。

accessible.en: The website was redesigned to make information more accessible to everyone.
accessible.zh: 網站重新設計，使資訊更容易讓所有人取得。

accessory.en: This small accessory lets the camera connect to a larger screen.
accessory.zh: 這個小配件可以讓相機連接到較大的螢幕。

accident.en: The road was closed for an hour after a minor accident.
accident.zh: 一場小事故後，道路封閉了一個小時。

accidental.en: The discovery was accidental, but it led to an important experiment.
accidental.zh: 這項發現是偶然的，卻促成了一個重要實驗。

acclaim.en: The young musician earned acclaim for her first public performance.
acclaim.zh: 這位年輕音樂家因首次公開演出而獲得讚譽。

accommodate.en: The hall can accommodate more than five hundred visitors at once.
accommodate.zh: 這座大廳一次可以容納五百多名訪客。

accommodation.en: The exchange program provides accommodation for students near the school.
accommodation.zh: 交換計畫為學生提供學校附近的住宿。

accompany.en: A teacher will accompany the students during the museum visit.
accompany.zh: 博物館參訪期間會有一位老師陪同學生。

accomplish.en: The team worked together to accomplish its goal before Friday.
accomplish.zh: 團隊合作在星期五前完成目標。

accomplishment.en: Finishing the difficult project gave her a strong sense of accomplishment.
accomplishment.zh: 完成這項困難的專題讓她很有成就感。

accord.en: The two groups reached an accord after several hours of discussion.
accord.zh: 兩個團體經過數小時討論後達成協議。

accordance.en: The experiment was conducted in accordance with the safety guidelines.
accordance.zh: 這項實驗依照安全規範進行。

accordingly.en: The weather forecast changed, so we adjusted our schedule accordingly.
accordingly.zh: 天氣預報改變，因此我們也相應調整了行程。

account.en: Please create an account before saving your progress online.
account.zh: 請先建立帳號，再儲存你的線上進度。

accountable.en: Group members should be accountable for the tasks they agree to complete.
accountable.zh: 小組成員應對自己答應完成的任務負責。

accountant.en: The accountant checked the records carefully before preparing the report.
accountant.zh: 會計人員在準備報告前仔細檢查了紀錄。

accounting.en: She became interested in accounting after taking a business course.
accounting.zh: 她修讀商業課程後開始對會計感興趣。

accumulate.en: Small errors can accumulate and affect the final result.
accumulate.zh: 小錯誤可能逐漸累積並影響最後結果。

accumulation.en: The accumulation of plastic waste has become a serious environmental problem.
accumulation.zh: 塑膠垃圾的累積已成為嚴重的環境問題。

accuracy.en: The researchers repeated the test to improve the accuracy of their measurements.
accuracy.zh: 研究人員重複測試，以提高測量的準確度。

accurate.en: Make sure the numbers are accurate before submitting the report.
accurate.zh: 提交報告前要確認數字正確。

accusation.en: The accusation was investigated before any decision was made.
accusation.zh: 在做出任何決定前，相關指控先接受了調查。

accuse.en: It is unfair to accuse someone without enough evidence.
accuse.zh: 在沒有足夠證據的情況下指控他人是不公平的。

accustom.en: It may take time to accustom yourself to a new schedule.
accustom.zh: 你可能需要一些時間讓自己適應新的作息。

ache.en: My shoulders began to ache after carrying the heavy bag all day.
ache.zh: 背著沉重的包包一整天後，我的肩膀開始痠痛。

achieve.en: Regular practice can help students achieve better results over time.
achieve.zh: 規律練習能幫助學生逐漸取得更好的成果。

achievement.en: Winning the science contest was a major achievement for the team.
achievement.zh: 贏得科學競賽是這個團隊的一項重大成就。

acid.en: The experiment showed how acid reacts with certain types of metal.
acid.zh: 實驗展示酸如何與某些種類的金屬反應。

acknowledge.en: The report should acknowledge the limits of the available data.
acknowledge.zh: 這份報告應承認現有資料的限制。

acquaintance.en: I met an old acquaintance while visiting the night market.
acquaintance.zh: 我逛夜市時遇到一位舊識。

acquire.en: Students acquire new skills faster when they practice them regularly.
acquire.zh: 學生規律練習時能更快習得新技能。

acquisition.en: Language acquisition usually requires both exposure and repeated practice.
acquisition.zh: 語言習得通常需要接觸與反覆練習。

acre.en: The farm includes an acre of land beside the river.
acre.zh: 這座農場包含河邊的一英畝土地。

across.en: We walked across the bridge before the rain became heavier.
across.zh: 雨勢變大前，我們走過了那座橋。

act.en: Students should act responsibly when using information from the internet.
act.zh: 學生使用網路資訊時應負責任地行事。

action.en: Quick action prevented the small problem from becoming much worse.
action.zh: 迅速採取行動避免小問題變得更嚴重。

active.en: Staying active can improve both physical health and concentration.
active.zh: 保持活躍有助於改善身體健康與專注力。

activity.en: The teacher planned a short activity to review the new vocabulary.
activity.zh: 老師安排了一個簡短活動來複習新單字。

actor.en: The actor practiced the difficult scene several times before filming.
actor.zh: 這位演員在拍攝前把困難的場景練習了好幾次。

actress.en: The actress gave an interview about her latest film project.
actress.zh: 這位女演員接受訪問，談到她最新的電影計畫。

actual.en: The actual cost was lower than our original estimate.
actual.zh: 實際成本比我們原本的估算低。

adapt.en: Animals must adapt when their environment changes rapidly.
adapt.zh: 動物在環境快速改變時必須適應。

adaptation.en: The film is an adaptation of a well-known historical novel.
adaptation.zh: 這部電影改編自一部知名的歷史小說。

add.en: Please add your name to the list before leaving.
add.zh: 離開前請把你的名字加到名單上。

addition.en: The library's new study area is a useful addition to the school.
addition.zh: 圖書館的新自習區是學校一項實用的新設施。

additional.en: The teacher provided additional examples to make the idea clearer.
additional.zh: 老師提供更多例子，讓這個觀念更清楚。

address.en: The speaker will address several questions at the end of the talk.
address.zh: 講者會在演講最後回應幾個問題。

adequate.en: We need adequate time to check the data before publishing it.
adequate.zh: 我們需要足夠時間在發布資料前進行檢查。

adjust.en: You may need to adjust your study plan before the exam.
adjust.zh: 考試前你可能需要調整讀書計畫。

adjustment.en: A small adjustment to the schedule solved the timing problem.
adjustment.zh: 對行程做一點調整就解決了時間安排問題。

administer.en: Trained staff will administer the survey to all participating students.
administer.zh: 受過訓練的工作人員會對所有參與學生進行問卷調查。

administration.en: The school administration announced the new policy on Monday morning.
administration.zh: 校方在星期一早上宣布了新政策。

administrative.en: The office handles administrative tasks such as forms and scheduling.
administrative.zh: 這間辦公室處理表格與排程等行政工作。

admire.en: I admire people who remain calm during difficult situations.
admire.zh: 我很佩服在困難情況下仍能保持冷靜的人。

admission.en: Admission to the museum is free for students on Fridays.
admission.zh: 學生星期五可免費進入博物館。

admit.en: He was willing to admit his mistake and correct it.
admit.zh: 他願意承認自己的錯誤並加以改正。

adolescent.en: The study examined sleep habits among adolescent students.
adolescent.zh: 這項研究探討青少年學生的睡眠習慣。

adopt.en: The school plans to adopt a new online learning system.
adopt.zh: 學校計畫採用新的線上學習系統。

adult.en: Every adult in the program received basic first-aid training.
adult.zh: 計畫中的每位成年人都接受了基礎急救訓練。

advance.en: Medical research continues to advance through international cooperation.
advance.zh: 醫學研究透過國際合作持續進步。

advanced.en: The course introduces advanced topics after students master the basics.
advanced.zh: 學生掌握基礎後，這門課會介紹較進階的主題。

advantage.en: One advantage of online resources is that they are easy to update.
advantage.zh: 線上資源的一個優點是容易更新。

adventure.en: The trip became an unexpected adventure when our train was delayed.
adventure.zh: 火車誤點後，這趟旅程變成了一場意外的冒險。

advertise.en: The club used posters to advertise its upcoming school event.
advertise.zh: 社團用海報宣傳即將舉行的校內活動。

advertisement.en: The advertisement used bright images to attract young customers.
advertisement.zh: 這則廣告使用鮮明圖片吸引年輕顧客。

advice.en: Her advice helped me organize my study schedule more effectively.
advice.zh: 她的建議幫助我更有效率地安排讀書時間。

advise.en: Teachers often advise students to review difficult material regularly.
advise.zh: 老師常建議學生定期複習困難的內容。

advocate.en: Many scientists advocate stronger action to protect natural habitats.
advocate.zh: 許多科學家主張採取更積極的行動保護自然棲地。

affair.en: The committee is responsible for student affair planning and campus events.
affair.zh: 這個委員會負責學生事務規劃與校園活動。

affect.en: Cold weather can affect how quickly some plants grow.
affect.zh: 寒冷天氣會影響某些植物的生長速度。

affection.en: The child showed affection for the dog by gently petting it.
affection.zh: 孩子輕輕撫摸小狗，表達對牠的喜愛。

afford.en: We cannot afford to waste time before the final deadline.
afford.zh: 在最後期限前，我們不能浪費時間。

afraid.en: She was afraid of making mistakes during her first speech.
afraid.zh: 她第一次演講時很害怕犯錯。

after.en: We discussed the results after everyone finished the experiment.
after.zh: 每個人完成實驗後，我們一起討論結果。

afternoon.en: The class will meet again tomorrow afternoon in the library.
afternoon.zh: 全班明天下午會在圖書館再次集合。

afterward.en: We finished the presentation and talked about the experience afterward.
afterward.zh: 我們完成報告後，又聊了聊這次經驗。

again.en: Please read the question again before choosing your final answer.
again.zh: 選擇最後答案前，請再讀一次題目。

against.en: The team played against a strong opponent in the final match.
against.zh: 這支隊伍在決賽中對上一個強勁的對手。

age.en: People of every age can benefit from regular physical activity.
age.zh: 各個年齡層的人都能從規律運動中受益。

agency.en: The government agency released a report on air quality.
agency.zh: 政府機關發布了一份空氣品質報告。

agenda.en: The first item on today's agenda is the class project.
agenda.zh: 今天議程的第一項是班級專題。

agent.en: The travel agent helped us compare several flight options.
agent.zh: 旅行社人員幫我們比較了幾個航班選項。

aggressive.en: The company used an aggressive marketing strategy to enter the new market.
aggressive.zh: 這家公司採取積極的行銷策略進入新市場。

ago.en: We first visited this museum two years ago.
ago.zh: 我們兩年前第一次參觀這座博物館。

agree.en: Most students agree that regular review helps them remember vocabulary.
agree.zh: 大多數學生都同意規律複習有助於記住單字。

agreement.en: The two schools signed an agreement to share teaching resources.
agreement.zh: 兩所學校簽署協議，共享教學資源。

agriculture.en: Modern agriculture often uses technology to reduce water consumption.
agriculture.zh: 現代農業常利用科技來減少用水量。

ahead.en: Please read the next chapter ahead of tomorrow's class.
ahead.zh: 請在明天上課前先閱讀下一章。

aid.en: The organization sent medical aid to the flooded area.
aid.zh: 該組織將醫療援助送往淹水地區。

aim.en: Our main aim is to make the information easier to understand.
aim.zh: 我們的主要目標是讓資訊更容易理解。

air.en: Fresh air entered the room when we opened the windows.
air.zh: 我們打開窗戶後，新鮮空氣進入房間。

aircraft.en: The aircraft landed safely despite the strong wind.
aircraft.zh: 儘管風很強，飛機仍安全降落。

airline.en: The airline announced a delay because of bad weather.
airline.zh: 航空公司因天候不佳宣布班機延誤。

airport.en: We arrived at the airport two hours before departure.
airport.zh: 我們在起飛前兩小時抵達機場。

alarm.en: The fire alarm rang during our afternoon class.
alarm.zh: 下午上課時火警警報響了。

album.en: She showed us a photo album from her trip to Japan.
album.zh: 她給我們看了她去日本旅行的相簿。

alcohol.en: The science class discussed how alcohol affects the human body.
alcohol.zh: 自然科課堂討論了酒精如何影響人體。

alert.en: The weather service issued an alert before the heavy rain began.
alert.zh: 大雨開始前，氣象單位發布了警報。

alien.en: The novel imagines an alien society living on a distant planet.
alien.zh: 這本小說想像一個生活在遙遠星球上的外星社會。

alike.en: The two designs look alike, but they work in different ways.
alike.zh: 這兩個設計看起來相似，但運作方式不同。

alive.en: The plant was still alive after several days without water.
alive.zh: 這株植物好幾天沒澆水後仍然活著。

all.en: All students must submit the form before Friday afternoon.
all.zh: 所有學生都必須在星期五下午前交表格。

allow.en: The new rule will allow students to borrow more books.
allow.zh: 新規定將允許學生借更多書。

allowance.en: Her monthly allowance is divided between savings and daily expenses.
allowance.zh: 她每月的零用錢分成儲蓄與日常花費。

almost.en: We almost missed the bus because the meeting ended late.
almost.zh: 因為會議太晚結束，我們差點錯過公車。

alone.en: She preferred to study alone when preparing for difficult exams.
alone.zh: 準備困難考試時，她比較喜歡自己讀書。

along.en: We walked along the river and took several photos.
along.zh: 我們沿著河邊散步並拍了幾張照片。

alongside.en: Students worked alongside local volunteers during the cleanup activity.
alongside.zh: 學生在清潔活動中與當地志工一起工作。

aloud.en: The teacher asked each student to read one sentence aloud.
aloud.zh: 老師請每位學生大聲朗讀一句話。

alphabet.en: Children usually learn the alphabet before they begin reading simple words.
alphabet.zh: 孩子通常先學字母表，才開始閱讀簡單單字。

already.en: I had already finished the homework before dinner.
already.zh: 我在晚餐前就已經完成作業。

also.en: The library has computers and also offers free internet access.
also.zh: 圖書館有電腦，也提供免費網路。

alter.en: A small change in temperature can alter the result of the experiment.
alter.zh: 溫度的小幅變化可能改變實驗結果。

alternative.en: Cycling is a healthy alternative to taking short car trips.
alternative.zh: 騎腳踏車是短程開車以外的健康選擇。

although.en: Although the test was difficult, most students finished on time.
although.zh: 雖然考試很難，大多數學生仍準時完成。

altogether.en: There were altogether thirty students in the final round.
altogether.zh: 決賽總共有三十名學生。

always.en: She always checks her answers before handing in a test.
always.zh: 她交考卷前總是會檢查答案。

amateur.en: The amateur photographer won a prize in the local contest.
amateur.zh: 這位業餘攝影師在地方比賽中獲獎。

amaze.en: The clear night sky can amaze visitors from large cities.
amaze.zh: 清澈的夜空常讓來自大城市的遊客感到驚奇。

ambassador.en: The ambassador spoke to students about international cooperation and culture.
ambassador.zh: 大使向學生談到國際合作與文化。

ambition.en: Her ambition is to become a researcher in environmental science.
ambition.zh: 她的志向是成為環境科學研究員。

ambitious.en: The students proposed an ambitious plan to reduce campus waste.
ambitious.zh: 學生提出了一項雄心勃勃的校園減廢計畫。

ambulance.en: An ambulance arrived within minutes after the accident was reported.
ambulance.zh: 事故通報後幾分鐘內救護車就到了。

among.en: The teacher divided the work among four small groups.
among.zh: 老師把工作分給四個小組。

amount.en: The amount of rainfall increased sharply during the summer.
amount.zh: 夏季的降雨量大幅增加。

amuse.en: The funny story managed to amuse everyone in the room.
amuse.zh: 那個有趣的故事逗樂了房間裡的每個人。

amusement.en: The park provides simple amusement for families with young children.
amusement.zh: 這座公園為有幼兒的家庭提供簡單的娛樂活動。

analysis.en: Our analysis showed a clear difference between the two groups.
analysis.zh: 我們的分析顯示兩組之間有明顯差異。

analyze.en: Scientists analyze the samples carefully before reporting their findings.
analyze.zh: 科學家在公布研究結果前會仔細分析樣本。

ancestor.en: The exhibition explains how one ancestor can connect many family branches.
ancestor.zh: 展覽說明一位祖先如何連結許多家族分支。

ancient.en: The museum displays tools used by people in ancient times.
ancient.zh: 博物館展示古代人使用的工具。

and.en: We compared the advantages and disadvantages before making a choice.
and.zh: 我們在做選擇前比較了優點和缺點。

anger.en: He took a short walk to calm his anger.
anger.zh: 他散了一小段步來平息怒氣。

angle.en: The camera was placed at a different angle for the second photo.
angle.zh: 第二張照片把相機放在不同角度。

angry.en: She felt angry because the decision seemed unfair.
angry.zh: 她因為覺得這個決定不公平而生氣。

animal.en: The zoo provides each animal with a suitable living environment.
animal.zh: 動物園為每隻動物提供合適的生活環境。

ankle.en: He injured his ankle while playing basketball after school.
ankle.zh: 他放學後打籃球時傷到了腳踝。

announce.en: The principal will announce the contest results tomorrow morning.
announce.zh: 校長明天早上會公布比賽結果。

announcement.en: The school made an announcement about the new class schedule.
announcement.zh: 學校發布了關於新課表的公告。

annoy.en: Repeated phone notifications can annoy people who are trying to study.
annoy.zh: 不斷出現的手機通知會打擾正在讀書的人。

annual.en: The school holds an annual sports day every spring.
annual.zh: 學校每年春天都會舉辦年度運動會。

another.en: If this method does not work, we can try another one.
another.zh: 如果這個方法沒有效，我們可以試另一個。

answer.en: Please explain how you reached your answer to the question.
answer.zh: 請說明你是如何得到這題答案的。

ant.en: An ant can carry objects much heavier than its own body.
ant.zh: 螞蟻能搬運比自己身體重很多的物體。

anticipate.en: We anticipate more visitors during the holiday weekend.
anticipate.zh: 我們預期連假期間會有更多訪客。

anxiety.en: Deep breathing can sometimes reduce anxiety before an important presentation.
anxiety.zh: 重要報告前做深呼吸有時能減輕焦慮。

anxious.en: Many students feel anxious before receiving important test results.
anxious.zh: 許多學生在收到重要考試成績前會感到焦慮。

any.en: Please ask if you have any questions about the assignment.
any.zh: 如果你對作業有任何問題，請提出來。

anybody.en: Anybody can join the club if they are interested in science.
anybody.zh: 任何對科學有興趣的人都可以加入這個社團。

anyhow.en: The weather was poor, but we enjoyed the trip anyhow.
anyhow.zh: 雖然天氣不好，我們還是很享受這趟旅行。

anyone.en: Anyone can improve with enough practice and useful feedback.
anyone.zh: 任何人只要有足夠練習和有用回饋都能進步。

anything.en: Do not change anything until the teacher checks the experiment.
anything.zh: 在老師檢查實驗前不要改動任何東西。

anyway.en: The bus was late, but we arrived on time anyway.
anyway.zh: 公車雖然晚到，我們最後還是準時抵達。

anywhere.en: With online materials, students can study almost anywhere.
anywhere.zh: 有了線上教材，學生幾乎可以在任何地方讀書。

apart.en: The two buildings stand about fifty meters apart.
apart.zh: 兩棟建築物相距約五十公尺。

apartment.en: Her apartment is close enough to walk to school.
apartment.zh: 她的公寓離學校很近，可以走路上學。

apologize.en: He decided to apologize after realizing that his comment was hurtful.
apologize.zh: 他發現自己的話傷人後決定道歉。

apology.en: Her apology helped the two friends resolve their disagreement.
apology.zh: 她的道歉幫助兩位朋友化解了爭執。

apparent.en: It became apparent that the original plan would cost too much.
apparent.zh: 很明顯原本的計畫成本會太高。

appeal.en: The campaign has strong appeal among young people who care about nature.
appeal.zh: 這項活動對關心自然的年輕人很有吸引力。

appear.en: Several stars appear just after the sun goes down.
appear.zh: 太陽下山後不久，幾顆星星就會出現。

appearance.en: The building's appearance changed after a major renovation.
appearance.zh: 這棟建築在大規模整修後外觀改變了。

appetite.en: A long hike can give you a strong appetite.
appetite.zh: 長時間健行會讓你很有食慾。

applaud.en: The audience began to applaud when the performance ended.
applaud.zh: 表演結束時，觀眾開始鼓掌。

apple.en: She packed an apple and a sandwich for lunch.
apple.zh: 她帶了一顆蘋果和一個三明治當午餐。

applicant.en: Each applicant must submit the form before the deadline.
applicant.zh: 每位申請者都必須在截止日前提交表格。

application.en: The scholarship application must be submitted before the end of March.
application.zh: 獎學金申請必須在三月底前送出。

apply.en: Students can apply for the program through the school website.
apply.zh: 學生可以透過學校網站申請這項計畫。

appoint.en: The club will appoint a new leader at next week's meeting.
appoint.zh: 社團會在下週會議任命新的負責人。

appointment.en: She made an appointment with the counselor after school.
appointment.zh: 她約了放學後和輔導老師會談。

appreciate.en: I appreciate your help with the final part of the project.
appreciate.zh: 我很感謝你協助完成專題的最後部分。

approach.en: The teacher used a practical approach to explain the difficult topic.
approach.zh: 老師用實際的方法解釋這個困難主題。

appropriate.en: Please choose appropriate language when writing a formal email.
appropriate.zh: 撰寫正式電子郵件時請使用適當的語言。

approval.en: The plan cannot begin until it receives official approval.
approval.zh: 這項計畫在獲得正式核准前不能開始。

approve.en: The committee will approve the proposal if it meets all requirements.
approve.zh: 如果提案符合所有要求，委員會就會批准。

architect.en: The architect designed the building to use more natural light.
architect.zh: 建築師設計這棟建築時增加了自然採光。

architecture.en: The city is famous for its mixture of old and modern architecture.
architecture.zh: 這座城市以新舊建築風格並存而聞名。

area.en: This area is famous for its hot springs and mountain views.
area.zh: 這個地區以溫泉和山景聞名。

argue.en: Students should argue their points with evidence rather than emotion.
argue.zh: 學生應該用證據而不是情緒來支持自己的論點。

argument.en: A strong argument needs clear reasons and reliable evidence.
argument.zh: 有力的論點需要清楚理由和可靠證據。

arise.en: New problems may arise when too many changes happen at once.
arise.zh: 一次發生太多變化時可能會出現新問題。

arm.en: He raised his arm to ask a question during class.

army.en: The history lesson explained how the army defended the city.
army.zh: 歷史課說明軍隊如何保衛這座城市。

around.en: We sat around the table and discussed the project together.
around.zh: 我們圍著桌子坐下，一起討論專題。

arrange.en: Please arrange the books by topic before putting them away.
arrange.zh: 請先依主題整理書籍，再把它們放回去。

arrangement.en: The seating arrangement made group discussion much easier.
arrangement.zh: 座位安排讓小組討論容易許多。

arrest.en: The police made an arrest after reviewing the security video.
arrest.zh: 警方查看監視錄影後進行逮捕。

arrival.en: We checked the arrival time before leaving for the station.
arrival.zh: 出發去車站前，我們先確認了抵達時間。

arrive.en: Please arrive ten minutes early for the interview.
arrive.zh: 面試請提早十分鐘到達。

arrow.en: The arrow on the map shows which direction to walk.
arrow.zh: 地圖上的箭頭顯示應該往哪個方向走。

art.en: The art class visited a gallery to study modern paintings.
art.zh: 美術課去畫廊研究現代畫作。

article.en: I found an interesting article about renewable energy online.
article.zh: 我在網路上找到一篇關於再生能源的有趣文章。

artificial.en: The laboratory used artificial light to control the growing conditions.
artificial.zh: 實驗室使用人工光線控制生長條件。

artist.en: The artist used recycled materials to create the sculpture.
artist.zh: 這位藝術家使用回收材料創作雕塑。

artistic.en: Her artistic skills improved after months of regular practice.
artistic.zh: 經過數月規律練習，她的藝術技巧進步了。

as.en: As the weather improved, more people returned to the park.
as.zh: 隨著天氣好轉，更多人回到公園。

ash.en: A thin layer of ash covered the ground after the eruption.
ash.zh: 火山爆發後，地面覆蓋著一層薄薄的火山灰。

aside.en: He put the book aside and started writing his notes.
aside.zh: 他把書放到一旁，開始寫筆記。

ask.en: Do not be afraid to ask for help when you need it.
ask.zh: 需要幫助時不要害怕開口求助。

asleep.en: The baby was already asleep when we arrived home.
asleep.zh: 我們到家時寶寶已經睡著了。

aspect.en: The report examines every important aspect of the problem.
aspect.zh: 這份報告檢視了這個問題的每個重要面向。

assault.en: The report examined how communities can prevent assault and improve public safety.
assault.zh: 這份報告探討社區如何預防暴力攻擊並提升公共安全。

assemble.en: Students will assemble the model after reading the instructions carefully.
assemble.zh: 學生仔細閱讀說明後會組裝模型。

assembly.en: The school assembly begins at eight thirty tomorrow morning.
assembly.zh: 明天早上八點半舉行全校集會。

assert.en: The writer should not assert a claim without supporting evidence.
assert.zh: 作者不應在沒有支持證據的情況下斷言。

assess.en: Teachers use several methods to assess student progress fairly.
assess.zh: 老師使用多種方法公平評量學生進步情況。

assessment.en: The final assessment includes both a written test and a presentation.
assessment.zh: 期末評量包含筆試和口頭報告。

assign.en: The teacher will assign each group a different research topic.
assign.zh: 老師會分配不同研究主題給每個小組。

assignment.en: The assignment requires students to compare two different viewpoints.
assignment.zh: 這份作業要求學生比較兩種不同觀點。

assist.en: Several volunteers came to assist with the school event.
assist.zh: 幾位志工前來協助學校活動。

assistance.en: Please ask for assistance if you cannot use the equipment safely.
assistance.zh: 如果你無法安全操作設備，請尋求協助。

assistant.en: The laboratory assistant prepared the materials before the experiment began.
assistant.zh: 實驗室助理在實驗開始前準備好材料。

associate.en: Many people associate this song with their high school years.
associate.zh: 許多人會把這首歌和高中時期聯想在一起。

association.en: The student association organized a charity event for the community.
association.zh: 學生會為社區舉辦了一場慈善活動。

assume.en: We should not assume the result before examining the data.
assume.zh: 在檢視資料前，我們不應先假設結果。

assure.en: The teacher tried to assure us that the test would be fair.
assure.zh: 老師試著向我們保證考試會公平。

astonish.en: The final score may astonish people who expected a close game.
astonish.zh: 最後比分可能讓原本預期比賽接近的人感到驚訝。

at.en: We will meet at the library entrance after school.
at.zh: 放學後我們會在圖書館入口集合。

athlete.en: The athlete trained every morning before going to school.
athlete.zh: 這名運動員每天上學前都會訓練。

athletic.en: The school built a new athletic field beside the gym.
athletic.zh: 學校在體育館旁新建了一座運動場。

atmosphere.en: The café has a quiet atmosphere that is suitable for studying.
atmosphere.zh: 這家咖啡店氣氛安靜，很適合讀書。

attach.en: Please attach the file before sending the email.
attach.zh: 寄出電子郵件前請先附上檔案。

attack.en: The article described a cyber attack on a large company.
attack.zh: 這篇文章描述一起針對大型公司的網路攻擊。

attempt.en: Her first attempt was unsuccessful, but she learned from it.
attempt.zh: 她第一次嘗試沒有成功，但她從中學到了東西。

attend.en: All team members should attend the meeting on Thursday.
attend.zh: 所有隊員都應參加星期四的會議。

attendance.en: Regular attendance is important for keeping up with the course.
attendance.zh: 規律出席對跟上課程進度很重要。

attention.en: Please pay close attention to the safety instructions before starting.
attention.zh: 開始前請仔細注意安全說明。

attitude.en: A positive attitude can help students face difficult tasks with confidence.
attitude.zh: 正向態度能幫助學生更有信心面對困難任務。

attract.en: Bright flowers attract many bees during the spring.
attract.zh: 鮮豔的花朵在春天會吸引許多蜜蜂。

attraction.en: The night market is a popular attraction for visitors to the city.
attraction.zh: 夜市是遊客來這座城市時很受歡迎的景點。

attractive.en: The website uses an attractive design that is easy to navigate.
attractive.zh: 這個網站採用美觀而且容易操作的設計。

audience.en: The audience asked several questions after the presentation ended.
audience.zh: 報告結束後，觀眾提出了幾個問題。

aunt.en: My aunt taught me how to cook this traditional dish.
aunt.zh: 我的阿姨教我做這道傳統料理。

author.en: The author explains the main idea clearly in the first chapter.
author.zh: 作者在第一章清楚說明了主要觀念。

authority.en: Local authority officials inspected the building after the earthquake.
authority.zh: 地方主管機關人員在地震後檢查了建築物。

automatic.en: The doors are automatic and open when someone approaches.
automatic.zh: 這些門是自動的，有人靠近時就會打開。

automobile.en: The museum displays an early automobile from the beginning of the twentieth century.
automobile.zh: 博物館展示了一輛二十世紀初期的早期汽車。

available.en: Extra practice materials are available on the class website.
available.zh: 班級網站上有額外的練習教材可供使用。

avenue.en: We walked down the avenue toward the main train station.
avenue.zh: 我們沿著大道往主要火車站走去。

average.en: The average score increased after students received more practice.
average.zh: 學生獲得更多練習後，平均分數提高了。

avoid.en: Try to avoid checking your phone while you are studying.
avoid.zh: 讀書時盡量避免查看手機。

awake.en: I was still awake when the storm started after midnight.
awake.zh: 半夜暴風雨開始時我還醒著。

award.en: She received an award for her excellent science project.
award.zh: 她因優秀的科學專題獲得獎項。

aware.en: Students should be aware of the risks of sharing personal information online.
aware.zh: 學生應了解在網路上分享個人資訊的風險。

away.en: The station is only a ten-minute walk away from school.
away.zh: 車站離學校走路只有十分鐘。

awesome.en: The view from the mountain was awesome after the clouds cleared.
awesome.zh: 雲散後，山上的景色令人驚嘆。

awful.en: The weather was awful, so the outdoor event was canceled.
awful.zh: 天氣很糟，因此戶外活動被取消。

baby.en: The baby smiled when she heard her mother's voice.
baby.zh: 寶寶聽到媽媽的聲音時笑了。

back.en: Please put the books back on the shelf after using them.
back.zh: 用完書後請把它們放回書架。

background.en: The article provides useful background information about the historical event.
background.zh: 這篇文章提供了關於這個歷史事件的實用背景資料。

backward.en: He took one backward step to avoid the moving bicycle.
backward.zh: 他往後退了一步，以避開移動中的腳踏車。

bacteria.en: Some bacteria are helpful and play important roles in digestion.
bacteria.zh: 有些細菌是有益的，並在消化中扮演重要角色。

bad.en: A bad habit can be difficult to change without a clear plan.
bad.zh: 沒有明確計畫時，壞習慣可能很難改掉。

badly.en: The road was badly damaged by the heavy rain.

bag.en: She placed her books and laptop in a large bag.
bag.zh: 她把書和筆電放進一個大袋子裡。

balance.en: Students need to balance schoolwork, rest, and personal interests.
balance.zh: 學生需要在課業、休息和個人興趣之間取得平衡。

ball.en: The ball rolled across the field and stopped near the fence.
ball.zh: 球滾過球場，最後停在圍欄附近。

ban.en: The city plans to ban smoking in several public areas.
ban.zh: 這座城市計畫禁止在數個公共區域吸菸。

banana.en: She packed a banana and some crackers for the trip.
banana.zh: 她為旅程帶了一根香蕉和一些餅乾。

band.en: The school band practiced every afternoon before the concert.
band.zh: 校樂隊在音樂會前每天午後練習。

bank.en: He went to the bank to deposit some money.

bar.en: The chart uses each bar to represent one category.
bar.zh: 這張圖表用每一根長條代表一個類別。

bare.en: The tree stood bare after all its leaves had fallen.
bare.zh: 樹葉全落後，那棵樹變得光禿禿的。

bargain.en: The jacket was a bargain because it was heavily discounted.
bargain.zh: 那件外套因為大幅折扣，所以很划算。

base.en: The statue stands on a wide stone base.
base.zh: 這座雕像立在寬大的石座上。

baseball.en: We played baseball after school until the sun went down.
baseball.zh: 我們放學後打棒球直到太陽下山。

basic.en: Students should understand the basic rules before starting the activity.
basic.zh: 學生在開始活動前應先了解基本規則。

basis.en: The team meets on a weekly basis to review progress.
basis.zh: 團隊每週固定開會檢視進度。

basket.en: She placed the fresh vegetables in a large basket.
basket.zh: 她把新鮮蔬菜放進一個大籃子裡。

basketball.en: Our basketball team practices three times a week after school.
basketball.zh: 我們的籃球隊每週放學後練習三次。

bath.en: A warm bath helped him relax after the long hike.
bath.zh: 長途健行後，洗個熱水澡讓他放鬆下來。

bathroom.en: The bathroom is located beside the stairs on the second floor.

battle.en: The history class discussed an important battle from the nineteenth century.
battle.zh: 歷史課討論了十九世紀的一場重要戰役。

beach.en: We collected plastic waste while walking along the beach.
beach.zh: 我們沿著海灘散步時撿拾塑膠垃圾。

bean.en: The class planted each bean in a small paper cup.
bean.zh: 全班把每顆豆子種在小紙杯裡。

bear.en: A bear was seen near the mountain trail yesterday morning.
bear.zh: 昨天早上有人在山徑附近看到一隻熊。

beat.en: The team managed to beat its strongest opponent in the final.
beat.zh: 這支隊伍成功在決賽中擊敗最強的對手。

beautiful.en: The mountain looked beautiful under the clear morning sky.
beautiful.zh: 在晴朗的晨空下，那座山看起來很美。

beauty.en: The beauty of the lake attracts many visitors every year.
beauty.zh: 這座湖的美景每年吸引許多遊客。

because.en: We stayed indoors because the rain became extremely heavy.
because.zh: 因為雨勢變得很大，我們待在室內。

become.en: With regular practice, difficult tasks can become much easier.
become.zh: 透過規律練習，困難的任務會變得容易許多。

bed.en: He went to bed early before the important exam.
bed.zh: 重要考試前，他很早就上床睡覺。

bedroom.en: Her bedroom has a desk beside the window.
bedroom.zh: 她的臥室窗邊有一張書桌。

bee.en: A bee landed on the flower beside the garden path.
bee.zh: 一隻蜜蜂停在花園小徑旁的花朵上。

beef.en: The restaurant serves noodles with beef and fresh vegetables.
beef.zh: 這家餐廳供應牛肉和新鮮蔬菜麵。

before.en: Please review the instructions before you begin the experiment.
before.zh: 開始實驗前請先複習操作說明。

begin.en: The meeting will begin at ten o'clock tomorrow morning.
begin.zh: 會議將在明天上午十點開始。

behavior.en: The teacher noticed a change in his classroom behavior.
behavior.zh: 老師注意到他在課堂行為上的改變。

behind.en: The bicycle was parked behind the library building.
behind.zh: 腳踏車停在圖書館建築後方。

belief.en: Her belief in teamwork helped the group stay united.
belief.zh: 她對團隊合作的信念幫助小組保持團結。

believe.en: I believe careful preparation can reduce stress before presentations.
believe.zh: 我相信充分準備能減少報告前的壓力。

bell.en: The bell rang just as the teacher finished speaking.
bell.zh: 老師剛講完時鐘聲正好響起。

belong.en: These books belong to the school library, not the classroom.
belong.zh: 這些書屬於學校圖書館，不是教室的。

below.en: Please write your answer in the space below the question.
below.zh: 請把答案寫在題目下方的空格中。

belt.en: He fastened his seat belt before the car started moving.
belt.zh: 車子開始移動前，他先繫好安全帶。

bench.en: We sat on a bench and watched people pass by.
bench.zh: 我們坐在長椅上看著人們經過。

bend.en: Do not bend the card because the chip may be damaged.
bend.zh: 不要彎折卡片，因為晶片可能會損壞。

beneath.en: A small storage room is located beneath the main staircase.
beneath.zh: 主樓梯下方有一間小儲藏室。

benefit.en: Regular exercise can benefit both physical and mental health.
benefit.zh: 規律運動對身心健康都有好處。

beside.en: She placed her notebook beside the computer before class began.
beside.zh: 上課前，她把筆記本放在電腦旁。

besides.en: Besides English, he is also studying Japanese this semester.
besides.zh: 除了英文之外，他這學期也在學日文。

best.en: The best solution is usually the one supported by clear evidence.
best.zh: 最好的解決方法通常是有明確證據支持的那一個。

better.en: You will understand the article better after learning these key words.
better.zh: 學會這些關鍵單字後，你會更理解這篇文章。

between.en: There is a clear difference between the two research methods.
between.zh: 這兩種研究方法之間有明顯差異。

beyond.en: The problem goes beyond money and involves public safety as well.
beyond.zh: 這個問題不只涉及金錢，也牽涉公共安全。

bicycle.en: She rides her bicycle to school on sunny days.
bicycle.zh: 天氣晴朗時，她會騎腳踏車上學。

big.en: A big decision should be made only after careful discussion.
big.zh: 重大決定應該在仔細討論後再做出。

bill.en: The electricity bill was higher than usual this month.
bill.zh: 這個月的電費帳單比平常高。

billion.en: The company invested nearly one billion dollars in new technology.
billion.zh: 這家公司在新科技上投資了將近十億元。

biology.en: Biology helps students understand how living things function and interact.
biology.zh: 生物學幫助學生了解生物如何運作與互動。

bird.en: A small bird built its nest near our classroom window.
bird.zh: 一隻小鳥在教室窗邊築巢。

birth.en: The hospital recorded a rise in birth rates last year.
birth.zh: 這家醫院記錄到去年出生率上升。

biscuit.en: She ate a biscuit with tea during the afternoon break.
biscuit.zh: 下午休息時，她配茶吃了一塊餅乾。

bit.en: The task became a bit easier after we read the example.
bit.zh: 看過範例後，這項任務變得容易了一點。

bite.en: Be careful because some insects may bite when disturbed.
bite.zh: 要小心，有些昆蟲受到干擾時可能會咬人。

bitter.en: The medicine tasted bitter, but it helped reduce the pain.
bitter.zh: 這藥味道很苦，但有助於減輕疼痛。

black.en: The teacher wrote the answer on the black board with chalk.
black.zh: 老師用粉筆把答案寫在黑色板面上。

blade.en: The machine stops automatically if the blade becomes blocked.
blade.zh: 如果刀片被卡住，機器會自動停止。

blame.en: It is not helpful to blame others without understanding the situation.
blame.zh: 不了解情況就責怪別人並沒有幫助。

blank.en: Leave the space blank if the question does not apply to you.
blank.zh: 如果問題不適用於你，請將該欄留白。

blanket.en: We brought a blanket to sit on during the picnic.
blanket.zh: 野餐時我們帶了一條毯子坐。

blind.en: The organization provides reading tools for blind students.
blind.zh: 這個組織為視障學生提供閱讀工具。

blood.en: The doctor ordered a blood test to check his health.
blood.zh: 醫師安排驗血以檢查他的健康狀況。

blow.en: Strong winds can blow loose objects across the street.
blow.zh: 強風可能把鬆動的物品吹到街上。

blue.en: The sky turned deep blue after the clouds disappeared.
blue.zh: 雲散去後，天空變成深藍色。

board.en: The teacher drew a simple diagram on the board.
board.zh: 老師在板上畫了一個簡單圖示。

boat.en: The small boat crossed the lake before sunset.
boat.zh: 那艘小船在日落前穿過湖面。

body.en: The human body needs enough sleep to recover properly.
body.zh: 人體需要充足睡眠才能好好恢復。

boil.en: Please boil the water before using it for the experiment.
boil.zh: 實驗使用這些水之前請先煮沸。

bone.en: Calcium is important for keeping each bone strong and healthy.
bone.zh: 鈣對維持每根骨頭強健很重要。

book.en: I borrowed a book about climate change from the library.
book.zh: 我從圖書館借了一本關於氣候變遷的書。

border.en: The river forms part of the border between the two regions.
border.zh: 這條河構成兩個地區之間部分邊界。

boring.en: The lecture was not boring because the speaker used many examples.
boring.zh: 這場演講並不無聊，因為講者用了很多例子。

born.en: She was born in Taiwan but grew up overseas.
born.zh: 她出生在台灣，但在海外長大。

borrow.en: Students may borrow up to five books at one time.
borrow.zh: 學生一次最多可以借五本書。

boss.en: The boss asked the team to finish the report by Friday.
boss.zh: 主管要求團隊在星期五前完成報告。

both.en: Both solutions are possible, but one is much more efficient.
both.zh: 兩種解法都可行，但其中一種有效率得多。

bother.en: Please do not bother other students while they are studying.
bother.zh: 其他學生讀書時請不要打擾他們。

bottle.en: Remember to bring a reusable bottle to reduce plastic waste.
bottle.zh: 記得攜帶可重複使用的水瓶，以減少塑膠垃圾。

bottom.en: The answer key is printed at the bottom of the page.

bowl.en: She poured the soup into a large bowl.
bowl.zh: 她把湯倒進一個大碗裡。

box.en: Please place the completed forms inside this box.
box.zh: 請把填好的表格放進這個箱子裡。

boy.en: The boy raised his hand to answer the teacher's question.
boy.zh: 那個男孩舉手回答老師的問題。

brain.en: Regular sleep helps the brain process and store new information.
brain.zh: 規律睡眠有助於大腦處理和儲存新資訊。

branch.en: A bird was resting on a branch above the path.
branch.zh: 一隻鳥停在小徑上方的樹枝上。

brand.en: The company introduced a new brand aimed at younger customers.
brand.zh: 這家公司推出了一個針對年輕顧客的新品牌。

brave.en: It was brave of her to speak honestly about the problem.
brave.zh: 她勇敢地誠實談論這個問題。

bread.en: He bought fresh bread from the bakery before breakfast.
bread.zh: 早餐前他從麵包店買了新鮮麵包。

break.en: Remember to take a short break after studying for an hour.
break.zh: 讀書一小時後記得休息一下。

breakfast.en: A healthy breakfast can help students concentrate during morning classes.
breakfast.zh: 健康的早餐有助於學生在上午課堂保持專注。

breath.en: She took a deep breath before starting her presentation.
breath.zh: 開始報告前，她深吸了一口氣。

breathe.en: Try to breathe slowly when you begin to feel nervous.
breathe.zh: 開始感到緊張時，試著慢慢呼吸。

bridge.en: The new bridge reduced travel time between the two towns.
bridge.zh: 新橋縮短了兩個城鎮之間的交通時間。

brief.en: The teacher gave a brief explanation before the group activity.
brief.zh: 小組活動前，老師做了簡短說明。

bring.en: Please bring your notebook and calculator to tomorrow's class.
bring.zh: 明天上課請帶筆記本和計算機。

broad.en: The survey covered a broad range of student opinions.
broad.zh: 這份調查涵蓋了廣泛的學生意見。

broadcast.en: The station will broadcast the final match live tonight.
broadcast.zh: 這家電台今晚將現場轉播決賽。

brother.en: My brother helped me practice for the English speaking test.
brother.zh: 我哥哥幫我練習英文口說測驗。

brown.en: The leaves turned brown after several weeks without rain.
brown.zh: 好幾週沒下雨後，葉子變成褐色。

brush.en: Remember to brush your teeth before going to bed.

build.en: The class worked together to build a simple model bridge.
build.zh: 全班合作製作了一座簡單的橋梁模型。

building.en: The new building has larger classrooms and better ventilation.
building.zh: 新建築有更大的教室和更好的通風。

burn.en: Dry leaves can burn quickly in hot and windy weather.
burn.zh: 乾燥樹葉在炎熱有風的天氣中很容易燃燒。

bus.en: We took the bus because the train service was delayed.
bus.zh: 因為火車延誤，我們改搭公車。

business.en: The class studied how a small business manages its costs.
business.zh: 全班研究小型企業如何管理成本。

busy.en: The library becomes especially busy during the week before exams.
busy.zh: 考試前一週圖書館會特別忙碌。

but.en: The plan sounded simple, but it required careful preparation.
but.zh: 這個計畫聽起來簡單，但需要仔細準備。

button.en: Press the green button to save your changes.
button.zh: 按下綠色按鈕以儲存變更。

buy.en: We decided to buy the cheaper model after comparing the features.
buy.zh: 比較功能後，我們決定購買較便宜的型號。

by.en: Please finish the assignment by Friday afternoon.
by.zh: 請在星期五下午前完成作業。

cabbage.en: The farmer grows cabbage and other vegetables during the cool season.
cabbage.zh: 農夫在涼爽季節種植高麗菜和其他蔬菜。

cage.en: The injured bird rested in a cage until it recovered.
cage.zh: 受傷的小鳥在籠子裡休養直到康復。

cake.en: She baked a chocolate cake for her friend's birthday.
cake.zh: 她為朋友生日烤了一個巧克力蛋糕。

calculate.en: Students learned to calculate the average using the survey results.
calculate.zh: 學生學會用調查結果計算平均值。

calendar.en: I wrote the exam date on my calendar so I would not forget.
calendar.zh: 我把考試日期寫在行事曆上，以免忘記。

call.en: Please call the office if you cannot attend the meeting.
call.zh: 如果你無法參加會議，請打電話到辦公室。

calm.en: She stayed calm even when the computer suddenly stopped working.
calm.zh: 即使電腦突然停止運作，她仍保持冷靜。

camera.en: The camera captured clear images of the night sky.
camera.zh: 這台相機拍下了清晰的夜空影像。

camp.en: The students stayed at a science camp during summer vacation.
camp.zh: 學生暑假期間參加了科學營。

campaign.en: The school started a campaign to reduce single-use plastic.
campaign.zh: 學校發起了一項減少一次性塑膠的活動。

campus.en: Visitors must wear identification while walking around the campus.
campus.zh: 訪客在校園內活動時必須佩戴識別證。

can.en: Regular practice can make difficult vocabulary easier to remember.
can.zh: 規律練習可以讓困難單字更容易記住。

cancel.en: The school may cancel the event if the storm becomes stronger.
cancel.zh: 如果暴風雨變強，學校可能取消活動。

cancer.en: The article explains how early screening can help detect cancer.
cancer.zh: 這篇文章說明早期篩檢如何幫助發現癌症。

candidate.en: Each candidate gave a short speech before the class election.
candidate.zh: 每位候選人在班級選舉前都發表了簡短演說。

capital.en: Taipei is the capital of Taiwan and an important transportation center.
capital.zh: 台北是台灣的首都，也是重要的交通中心。

captain.en: The captain encouraged the team after they lost the first game.
captain.zh: 球隊輸掉第一場比賽後，隊長鼓勵了大家。

capture.en: The photographer tried to capture the changing colors of the sunset.
capture.zh: 攝影師試著捕捉夕陽不斷變化的色彩。

car.en: We left the car at home and took the train instead.
car.zh: 我們把車留在家裡，改搭火車。

card.en: Each student received a card with a different discussion question.
card.zh: 每位學生都拿到一張寫有不同討論題目的卡片。

care.en: Students should take care when handling glass equipment in the laboratory.
care.zh: 學生在實驗室操作玻璃器材時應小心。

career.en: She is considering a career in medicine or public health.
career.zh: 她正在考慮從事醫學或公共衛生相關工作。

careful.en: Be careful when entering data because small mistakes can affect results.
careful.zh: 輸入資料時要小心，因為小錯誤可能影響結果。

carry.en: This backpack can carry a laptop and several heavy books.
carry.zh: 這個背包可以裝一台筆電和好幾本厚書。

case.en: In this case, waiting for more information is the safest choice.
case.zh: 在這種情況下，等待更多資訊是最安全的選擇。

cash.en: The small shop accepts both cash and electronic payments.
cash.zh: 這家小店同時接受現金和電子支付。

cat.en: The cat slept quietly under the chair during the afternoon.
cat.zh: 那隻貓下午安靜地睡在椅子下。

catch.en: We ran to catch the last bus home.
catch.zh: 我們跑去趕最後一班回家的公車。

category.en: Each book is placed in a category based on its subject.
category.zh: 每本書都依主題被歸入一個類別。

cause.en: Lack of sleep can cause problems with concentration and memory.
cause.zh: 睡眠不足可能造成專注力和記憶方面的問題。

ceiling.en: A small fan was installed in the ceiling above the desk.
ceiling.zh: 書桌上方的天花板裝了一台小風扇。

celebrate.en: The class will celebrate the end of the semester with a small party.
celebrate.zh: 全班會用一個小聚會慶祝學期結束。

celebration.en: The graduation celebration included music, speeches, and student performances.
celebration.zh: 畢業慶祝活動包含音樂、演說和學生表演。

center.en: The community center offers free study space on weekends.
center.zh: 社區中心週末提供免費自習空間。

central.en: The station is located in the central part of the city.
central.zh: 車站位於城市中心地區。

century.en: The building was constructed near the end of the nineteenth century.
century.zh: 這棟建築建於十九世紀末期。

ceremony.en: The award ceremony will begin immediately after the final performance.
ceremony.zh: 頒獎典禮會在最後一場表演後立刻開始。

certain.en: We need to be certain that the data is accurate before publishing it.
certain.zh: 發布資料前，我們必須確定資料正確。

chair.en: Please move your chair closer to the table before we begin.
chair.zh: 開始前請把椅子移近桌子。

chairman.en: The chairman opened the meeting with a brief introduction.
chairman.zh: 主席用簡短介紹為會議揭開序幕。

challenge.en: Learning to speak confidently is a challenge for many students.
challenge.zh: 學會有自信地說話對許多學生來說是一項挑戰。

chance.en: This program gives students a chance to practice speaking English.
chance.zh: 這項計畫讓學生有機會練習說英文。

change.en: A small change in routine can sometimes improve study efficiency.
change.zh: 日常作息的小改變有時能提升讀書效率。

channel.en: The school uses an online channel to share important announcements.
channel.zh: 學校使用線上頻道發布重要公告。

chapter.en: Please read the next chapter before Wednesday's discussion.
chapter.zh: 請在星期三討論前讀完下一章。

character.en: The main character changes greatly during the course of the story.
character.zh: 故事中的主角在情節發展過程中有很大的改變。

charge.en: The hotel does not charge students for using the study room.
charge.zh: 這家旅館不向學生收取使用自習室的費用。

chart.en: The chart shows how student performance changed over three years.
chart.zh: 這張圖表顯示學生表現三年來的變化。

check.en: Please check your answers before submitting the online form.
check.zh: 提交線上表單前請檢查答案。

cheer.en: The crowd began to cheer when the team scored.
cheer.zh: 球隊得分時，人群開始歡呼。

chemical.en: Students must wear gloves when handling this chemical in class.
chemical.zh: 學生在課堂上處理這種化學物質時必須戴手套。

chemistry.en: Chemistry helps explain how different substances react with each other.
chemistry.zh: 化學幫助我們了解不同物質如何彼此反應。

chicken.en: The restaurant serves grilled chicken with rice and vegetables.
chicken.zh: 這家餐廳供應烤雞配飯和蔬菜。

child.en: Every child needs enough sleep for healthy growth and learning.
child.zh: 每個孩子都需要充足睡眠，以維持健康成長與學習。

choice.en: You have a choice between taking the bus or walking.
choice.zh: 你可以選擇搭公車或走路。

choose.en: Please choose the answer that best matches the passage.
choose.zh: 請選擇最符合文章內容的答案。

church.en: The old church has stood in the town for over a century.
church.zh: 這座老教堂已在鎮上矗立超過一個世紀。

circle.en: Draw a circle around the correct answer on the worksheet.
circle.zh: 請在學習單上的正確答案外畫一個圓圈。

circumstance.en: Under this circumstance, waiting for more information is the safest choice.
circumstance.zh: 在這種情況下，等待更多資訊是最安全的選擇。

citizen.en: Every citizen has a role in keeping the community clean.
citizen.zh: 每位公民都有責任協助維持社區整潔。

city.en: The city added more bicycle lanes to reduce traffic congestion.
city.zh: 這座城市增設更多自行車道，以減少交通壅塞。

civil.en: The discussion remained civil even when the students strongly disagreed.
civil.zh: 即使學生意見分歧很大，討論仍保持理性有禮。

civilian.en: The museum tells stories about civilian life during the war.
civilian.zh: 博物館介紹戰爭期間平民生活的故事。

claim.en: The article makes a claim that is supported by several studies.
claim.zh: 這篇文章提出一項由多項研究支持的主張。

class.en: Our class will visit the science museum next Friday.
class.zh: 我們班下星期五要參觀科學博物館。

classic.en: The library displayed a classic novel that has remained popular for decades.
classic.zh: 圖書館展示了一本數十年來仍受歡迎的經典小說。

classical.en: She listens to classical music while doing quiet homework.
classical.zh: 她做需要安靜完成的作業時會聽古典音樂。

classify.en: Students learned to classify animals according to shared characteristics.
classify.zh: 學生學會依共同特徵將動物分類。

classmate.en: My classmate helped me understand the final math problem.
classmate.zh: 我的同學幫我理解最後一道數學題。

clean.en: Please clean the equipment carefully after finishing the experiment.
clean.zh: 實驗完成後請仔細清潔器材。

clear.en: A clear explanation makes a difficult idea easier to understand.
clear.zh: 清楚的解釋能讓困難的觀念更容易理解。

clerk.en: The store clerk helped us find the correct size.
clerk.zh: 店員幫我們找到正確的尺寸。

clever.en: She found a clever way to solve the problem with fewer steps.
clever.zh: 她找到一個用更少步驟解決問題的聰明方法。

click.en: Click the save button before closing the document.
click.zh: 關閉文件前請點擊儲存按鈕。

client.en: The designer met with the client to discuss the new website.
client.zh: 設計師與客戶見面討論新網站。

climate.en: Scientists study climate patterns to understand long-term environmental change.
climate.zh: 科學家研究氣候模式，以了解長期環境變化。

climb.en: We began to climb the hill before sunrise.
climb.zh: 我們在日出前開始爬上山坡。

clock.en: The clock on the wall was five minutes slow.
clock.zh: 牆上的時鐘慢了五分鐘。

close.en: Please close the window before leaving the classroom.
close.zh: 離開教室前請把窗戶關上。

cloth.en: Use a soft cloth to clean the computer screen.
cloth.zh: 請用柔軟的布清潔電腦螢幕。

clothes.en: She packed warm clothes because the mountain weather was cold.
clothes.zh: 因為山區天氣寒冷，她帶了保暖衣物。

cloud.en: A dark cloud appeared above the mountains before the storm.
cloud.zh: 暴風雨前，一大片烏雲出現在山上。

club.en: The science club meets every Wednesday after school.
club.zh: 科學社每星期三放學後聚會。

coach.en: The coach encouraged the players to communicate during the game.
coach.zh: 教練鼓勵球員在比賽中互相溝通。

coal.en: Burning coal produces energy but also releases carbon dioxide.
coal.zh: 燃燒煤可以產生能源，但也會排放二氧化碳。

coast.en: The storm moved slowly along the eastern coast overnight.
coast.zh: 暴風雨整夜沿著東部海岸緩慢移動。

coat.en: He wore a thick coat because the morning was unusually cold.
coat.zh: 因為早晨異常寒冷，他穿了一件厚外套。

code.en: Students wrote simple code to control the small robot.
code.zh: 學生寫了簡單程式碼來控制小型機器人。

coffee.en: She bought a cup of coffee before the morning meeting.
coffee.zh: 早會前她買了一杯咖啡。

coin.en: The old coin was displayed behind glass in the museum.
coin.zh: 這枚古老硬幣被陳列在博物館的玻璃櫃後。

cold.en: The water felt extremely cold after the temperature dropped overnight.
cold.zh: 夜間降溫後，水摸起來非常冰冷。

collapse.en: The weak structure could collapse if too much weight was added.
collapse.zh: 如果加上過多重量，這個脆弱結構可能會倒塌。

collect.en: Students collect data every week for their science project.
collect.zh: 學生每週為科學專題蒐集資料。

collection.en: The museum has a large collection of traditional tools.
collection.zh: 這座博物館收藏了大量傳統工具。

college.en: She plans to study engineering when she enters college.
college.zh: 她計畫上大學後念工程。

color.en: The leaves change color when the weather becomes cooler.
color.zh: 天氣變涼時，樹葉會變色。

column.en: Write each answer in the correct column of the table.
column.zh: 請把每個答案寫在表格正確的欄位中。

combine.en: We can combine the two ideas into one stronger proposal.
combine.zh: 我們可以把兩個想法結合成一個更完整的提案。

come.en: Many useful ideas come from asking simple questions.
come.zh: 許多實用想法都來自提出簡單問題。

comfort.en: A quiet room can provide comfort after a stressful day.
comfort.zh: 忙碌有壓力的一天後，安靜的房間能帶來舒適感。

comfortable.en: These chairs are comfortable enough for long study sessions.
comfortable.zh: 這些椅子很舒適，適合長時間讀書。

command.en: The computer will follow each command in the order given.
command.zh: 電腦會依照輸入順序執行每一道指令。

comment.en: The teacher wrote a helpful comment beside my final paragraph.
comment.zh: 老師在我最後一段旁寫了一則有幫助的評語。

commerce.en: Online commerce has changed how people buy everyday products.
commerce.zh: 線上商業改變了人們購買日常用品的方式。

commercial.en: The commercial used humor to make the product memorable.
commercial.zh: 這則廣告用幽默讓產品更令人印象深刻。

commit.en: Students should commit enough time to preparing for major exams.
commit.zh: 學生應投入足夠時間準備重要考試。

committee.en: The committee will review the proposal at tomorrow's meeting.
committee.zh: 委員會會在明天的會議審查這項提案。

common.en: Stress is a common problem among students during exam season.
common.zh: 考試期間，壓力是學生常見的問題。

communicate.en: Group members should communicate clearly when dividing their tasks.
communicate.zh: 小組成員分配工作時應清楚溝通。

communication.en: Good communication can prevent many problems in group projects.
communication.zh: 良好溝通能避免小組專題中的許多問題。

community.en: The community organized a weekend cleanup around the local park.
community.zh: 社區在週末舉辦了當地公園清潔活動。

company.en: The company plans to reduce its energy use next year.
company.zh: 這家公司計畫明年降低能源使用量。

compare.en: Please compare the two graphs before answering the question.
compare.zh: 回答問題前請比較這兩張圖表。

comparison.en: The report includes a comparison of three different learning methods.
comparison.zh: 這份報告比較了三種不同的學習方法。

compete.en: Several schools will compete in the regional science contest.
compete.zh: 數所學校將參加地區科學競賽。

competition.en: The competition attracted students from across the country.
competition.zh: 這項比賽吸引了全國各地的學生。

competitive.en: The scholarship program is highly competitive this year.
competitive.zh: 今年這項獎學金計畫競爭非常激烈。

complain.en: Some residents complain about the noise from late-night traffic.
complain.zh: 一些居民抱怨深夜交通造成的噪音。

complete.en: Please complete the survey before the end of class.
complete.zh: 請在下課前完成這份問卷。

complex.en: The teacher used a diagram to explain the complex process.
complex.zh: 老師用圖示來解釋這個複雜過程。

complicate.en: Too many extra rules can complicate a simple procedure.
complicate.zh: 太多額外規定可能讓簡單程序變得複雜。

component.en: Each component must be tested before the machine is assembled.
component.zh: 機器組裝前，每個零件都必須先測試。

compose.en: Students were asked to compose a short paragraph using the new words.
compose.zh: 學生被要求用新單字寫一小段文章。

composition.en: Her composition had a clear introduction and a strong conclusion.
composition.zh: 她的作文有清楚的開頭和有力的結尾。

computer.en: The school replaced several old computer units in the library.
computer.zh: 學校更換了圖書館裡幾台老舊電腦。

concentrate.en: It is easier to concentrate when your phone is turned off.
concentrate.zh: 手機關機時比較容易專心。

concentration.en: Noise can reduce concentration during difficult reading tasks.
concentration.zh: 噪音會降低進行困難閱讀時的專注力。

concept.en: The teacher explained the concept with a simple everyday example.
concept.zh: 老師用簡單的日常例子解釋這個概念。

concern.en: Air pollution is a major concern in many large cities.
concern.zh: 空氣污染是許多大城市的重要問題。

concert.en: The school concert will take place in the main hall tonight.
concert.zh: 學校音樂會今晚會在大禮堂舉行。

conclude.en: We cannot conclude anything until all the results are checked.
conclude.zh: 在所有結果都檢查完成前，我們不能下結論。

conclusion.en: The conclusion summarizes the main findings of the report.
conclusion.zh: 結論總結了報告的主要發現。

concrete.en: Please give a concrete example to support your argument.
concrete.zh: 請舉一個具體例子支持你的論點。

condition.en: The equipment must be kept in good condition for safety.
condition.zh: 為了安全，設備必須保持良好狀態。

conduct.en: The students will conduct a survey about reading habits.
conduct.zh: 學生將進行一項關於閱讀習慣的調查。

conference.en: The teacher attended an education conference during the weekend.
conference.zh: 老師週末參加了一場教育研討會。

confidence.en: Regular speaking practice can build confidence over time.
confidence.zh: 規律口說練習能逐漸建立自信。

confident.en: She felt confident after practicing her presentation several times.
confident.zh: 練習報告好幾次後，她感到很有自信。

confirm.en: Please confirm the meeting time before making travel arrangements.
confirm.zh: 安排交通前請先確認會議時間。

conflict.en: Clear communication can prevent a small disagreement from becoming conflict.
conflict.zh: 清楚溝通能避免小歧見演變成衝突。

confuse.en: Similar spelling can confuse students who are learning new vocabulary.
confuse.zh: 相似的拼字可能讓正在學新單字的學生混淆。

connect.en: This bridge will connect the two sides of the river.
connect.zh: 這座橋將連接河流兩岸。

connection.en: The study found a connection between sleep and memory performance.
connection.zh: 這項研究發現睡眠與記憶表現之間有關聯。

consequence.en: One consequence of poor planning is unnecessary stress.
consequence.zh: 規劃不佳的一個後果是不必要的壓力。

consider.en: Please consider all the evidence before making your decision.
consider.zh: 做決定前請考慮所有證據。

considerable.en: The project required a considerable amount of time and effort.
considerable.zh: 這項專題需要相當多的時間與努力。

consist.en: The final exam will consist of four different sections.
consist.zh: 期末考將由四個不同部分組成。

constant.en: Constant practice is more effective than studying only before tests.
constant.zh: 持續練習比只在考前讀書更有效。

construct.en: Students used wooden sticks to construct a small bridge model.
construct.zh: 學生用木棒搭建一座小型橋梁模型。

construction.en: Road construction caused heavy traffic near the school this morning.
construction.zh: 道路施工造成今天早上學校附近交通壅塞。

contact.en: Please contact the office if your schedule changes.
contact.zh: 如果你的行程有變，請聯絡辦公室。

contain.en: This box may contain materials needed for the experiment.
contain.zh: 這個箱子可能裝有實驗所需材料。

container.en: Store the liquid in a clean container with a tight lid.
container.zh: 請把液體存放在有密封蓋的乾淨容器裡。

content.en: The teacher reviewed the content before giving the final quiz.
content.zh: 老師在期末小考前複習了課程內容。

contest.en: Our team entered a writing contest organized by the library.
contest.zh: 我們的隊伍參加了圖書館舉辦的寫作比賽。

context.en: The context can help you guess the meaning of an unfamiliar word.
context.zh: 語境能幫助你猜出陌生單字的意思。

continue.en: We will continue the discussion after everyone finishes reading.
continue.zh: 等大家讀完後，我們會繼續討論。

contract.en: The company signed a contract with a local supplier.
contract.zh: 這家公司與當地供應商簽了一份合約。

contrast.en: The essay shows a clear contrast between the two characters.
contrast.zh: 這篇文章清楚呈現兩個角色之間的對比。

contribute.en: Every student should contribute at least one idea to the project.
contribute.zh: 每位學生都應至少為專題提供一個想法。

control.en: The experiment shows how temperature can control the speed of a reaction.
control.zh: 這個實驗顯示溫度如何控制反應速度。

convenient.en: Online registration is convenient for students who live far away.
convenient.zh: 線上報名對住得遠的學生很方便。

conversation.en: A short conversation can reveal how differently people view the same issue.
conversation.zh: 短短一段對話就能看出人們對同一議題的不同看法。

cook.en: We learned to cook a simple meal during the class activity.
cook.zh: 我們在課堂活動中學會煮一道簡單餐點。

cool.en: Keep the medicine in a cool place away from sunlight.
cool.zh: 請把藥品放在陰涼且避免陽光直射的地方。

cooperate.en: Students must cooperate if they want the group project to succeed.
cooperate.zh: 學生若想讓小組專題成功，就必須合作。

cooperation.en: The event succeeded because of strong cooperation among all the volunteers.
cooperation.zh: 這場活動因所有志工通力合作而成功。

copy.en: Please copy the sentence carefully into your notebook.
copy.zh: 請把這個句子仔細抄到筆記本上。

corner.en: The bookstore is located on the corner across from the station.
corner.zh: 書店位於車站對面的街角。

correct.en: Please check whether your final answer is correct.
correct.zh: 請檢查你的最後答案是否正確。

cost.en: The total cost was lower than we had expected.
cost.zh: 總成本比我們原先預期的低。

cotton.en: This shirt is made from soft cotton that feels comfortable.
cotton.zh: 這件襯衫由柔軟棉布製成，穿起來很舒服。

council.en: The student council organized a meeting about campus safety.
council.zh: 學生會舉辦了一場關於校園安全的會議。

count.en: Please count the number of responses before entering the data.
count.zh: 輸入資料前請先數回覆的數量。

country.en: Each country faces different challenges in protecting the environment.
country.zh: 每個國家在環境保護方面面臨不同挑戰。

couple.en: We waited a couple of minutes for the bus to arrive.
couple.zh: 我們等了幾分鐘讓公車到站。

courage.en: It takes courage to admit a mistake in front of others.
courage.zh: 在別人面前承認錯誤需要勇氣。

course.en: This course teaches students how to analyze scientific data.
course.zh: 這門課教學生如何分析科學資料。

court.en: The school has a basketball court behind the gym.
court.zh: 學校體育館後方有一座籃球場。

cover.en: The final test will cover all the chapters we studied.
cover.zh: 期末考會涵蓋我們讀過的所有章節。

create.en: Students used recycled materials to create useful classroom objects.
create.zh: 學生用回收材料製作實用的教室物品。

creative.en: The project encourages students to develop creative solutions to real problems.
creative.zh: 這項專題鼓勵學生為真實問題發展有創意的解決方案。

credit.en: The report gives credit to everyone who contributed to the research.
credit.zh: 這份報告對所有參與研究的人給予應有肯定。

crime.en: The article examines how technology is used to prevent crime.
crime.zh: 這篇文章探討科技如何被用來預防犯罪。

crisis.en: Clear communication is especially important during a crisis.
crisis.zh: 在危機期間，清楚溝通尤其重要。

criticize.en: It is easier to criticize a plan than to suggest a better one.
criticize.zh: 批評一個計畫比提出更好的方案容易。

crop.en: The farmers changed the crop after several seasons of poor rainfall.
crop.zh: 連續幾季降雨不足後，農民更換了作物。

cross.en: Use the bridge to cross the river safely.

crowd.en: A large crowd gathered outside the stadium before the game.
crowd.zh: 比賽前，一大群人聚集在體育場外。

crucial.en: Good planning is crucial when a project has a short deadline.
crucial.zh: 專題期限很短時，良好規劃非常重要。

culture.en: Food is an important part of every culture.
culture.zh: 飲食是每種文化的重要一部分。

cup.en: She filled a cup with warm water before class.
cup.zh: 上課前，她倒了一杯溫水。

current.en: The report describes the current situation and suggests possible improvements.
current.zh: 這份報告描述目前情況並提出可能的改善方式。

customer.en: The store asked each customer to complete a short survey.
customer.zh: 商店請每位顧客填寫一份簡短問卷。

cut.en: Use scissors to cut the paper along the dotted line.
cut.zh: 請用剪刀沿著虛線剪紙。

cycle.en: The diagram shows the complete water cycle from evaporation to rainfall.
cycle.zh: 這張圖示顯示從蒸發到降雨的完整水循環。

daily.en: A short daily review can help students remember new vocabulary.
daily.zh: 每天做一點簡短複習能幫助學生記住新單字。

damage.en: Heavy rain caused serious damage to several mountain roads.
damage.zh: 大雨對幾條山區道路造成嚴重損害。

dance.en: The students learned a traditional dance for the school festival.
dance.zh: 學生為校慶學了一支傳統舞蹈。

danger.en: The sign warns visitors about the danger of falling rocks.
danger.zh: 這個標誌提醒遊客注意落石危險。

dangerous.en: It is dangerous to use electrical equipment near water.
dangerous.zh: 在水邊使用電器設備很危險。

dark.en: The room became dark when the power suddenly went out.
dark.zh: 突然停電時，房間變得一片漆黑。

data.en: The researchers checked the data carefully before drawing conclusions.
data.zh: 研究人員在下結論前仔細檢查資料。

date.en: Please write the date at the top of your worksheet.
date.zh: 請在學習單上方寫上日期。

daughter.en: His daughter enjoys reading science books after school.
daughter.zh: 他的女兒放學後喜歡閱讀科學書籍。

day.en: We spent the whole day preparing for the presentation.
day.zh: 我們花了一整天準備報告。

dead.en: The plant was dead because it had not received enough water.
dead.zh: 這株植物因為沒有得到足夠的水而枯死。

deal.en: The class discussed how to deal with stress before exams.
deal.zh: 全班討論考試前如何處理壓力。

dear.en: She wrote a short letter beginning with Dear Grandma.
dear.zh: 她寫了一封以親愛的奶奶開頭的短信。

death.en: The article explains how pollution can increase the risk of early death.
death.zh: 這篇文章說明污染如何增加早逝風險。

debate.en: The students held a debate about whether uniforms should be required.
debate.zh: 學生就是否應要求穿制服進行辯論。

debt.en: The family worked hard to reduce its debt over several years.
debt.zh: 這個家庭花了好幾年努力減少債務。

decade.en: The city has changed greatly over the past decade.
decade.zh: 這座城市在過去十年間有很大變化。

decide.en: We need more information before we decide what to do.
decide.zh: 我們需要更多資訊才能決定要怎麼做。

decision.en: She made her decision after comparing all three options.
decision.zh: 她比較三個選項後做出了決定。

declare.en: The officials will declare the final results tomorrow morning.
declare.zh: 相關人員會在明天早上宣布最終結果。

decline.en: The report shows a decline in plastic waste after the new policy.
decline.zh: 報告顯示新政策實施後塑膠垃圾有所下降。

decorate.en: Students helped decorate the classroom for the graduation celebration.
decorate.zh: 學生幫忙布置教室以迎接畢業慶祝活動。

decrease.en: The new system helped decrease waiting time at the school office.
decrease.zh: 新系統幫助縮短了校務處的等候時間。

deep.en: The lake is too deep to cross safely on foot.
deep.zh: 這座湖太深，無法安全徒步穿越。

defeat.en: The team refused to give up after its first defeat.
defeat.zh: 球隊在第一次落敗後仍拒絕放棄。

defend.en: The lawyer used strong evidence to defend the accused person.
defend.zh: 律師用有力證據為被告辯護。

defense.en: Good defense helped the team protect its narrow lead.
defense.zh: 良好的防守幫助球隊守住微弱領先。

define.en: Please define the key term before using it in your essay.
define.zh: 在文章中使用這個關鍵詞前，請先加以定義。

definite.en: We need a definite answer before booking the tickets.
definite.zh: 我們需要明確答案後才能訂票。

delay.en: Heavy traffic caused a delay of nearly thirty minutes.
delay.zh: 交通壅塞造成將近三十分鐘的延誤。

deliberate.en: The committee made a deliberate choice after reviewing all the evidence.
deliberate.zh: 委員會在審查所有證據後做出了審慎的選擇。

delicate.en: The glass model is delicate and should be handled carefully.
delicate.zh: 這個玻璃模型很脆弱，應小心拿取。

delicious.en: The soup was simple but surprisingly delicious.
delicious.zh: 這道湯很簡單，卻意外地美味。

deliver.en: The company will deliver the new computers to school next week.
deliver.zh: 公司下週會把新電腦送到學校。

delivery.en: The delivery arrived earlier than the office had expected.
delivery.zh: 這批貨比辦公室預期更早送達。

demand.en: There is growing demand for cleaner sources of energy.
demand.zh: 人們對更潔淨能源的需求正在增加。

demonstrate.en: The teacher used a model to demonstrate how the machine works.
demonstrate.zh: 老師用模型示範這台機器如何運作。

deny.en: He did not deny making the mistake in the report.
deny.zh: 他沒有否認自己在報告中犯了錯。

department.en: The science department organized a special lecture for students.
department.zh: 自然科部門為學生舉辦了一場特別講座。

depend.en: The final result will depend on how carefully we collect the data.
depend.zh: 最後結果將取決於我們蒐集資料時有多仔細。

dependent.en: Young children are often dependent on adults for daily care.
dependent.zh: 年幼兒童的日常照顧常依賴成年人。

deposit.en: You need to pay a small deposit before borrowing the equipment.
deposit.zh: 借用設備前需要先支付一小筆押金。

depress.en: Long periods of bad weather can depress people's mood.
depress.zh: 長時間的壞天氣可能使人的情緒低落。

depth.en: The students measured the depth of the water near the shore.
depth.zh: 學生測量了岸邊水域的深度。

describe.en: Please describe what you observed during the experiment.
describe.zh: 請描述你在實驗中觀察到的現象。

description.en: The website provides a short description of each course.
description.zh: 網站提供每門課的簡短說明。

desert.en: Very little rain falls in this desert each year.
desert.zh: 這片沙漠每年的降雨量很少。

deserve.en: Students who worked hard deserve recognition for their effort.
deserve.zh: 努力付出的學生值得因他們的努力受到肯定。

design.en: Students helped design a poster for the environmental campaign.
design.zh: 學生協助設計環保活動海報。

designer.en: The designer created a simple layout that was easy to read.
designer.zh: 設計師做出了一個簡單而容易閱讀的版面。

desire.en: Her desire to improve motivated her to practice every day.
desire.zh: 她想進步的渴望促使她每天練習。

desk.en: My notes were still on the desk after class ended.
desk.zh: 下課後我的筆記還放在桌上。

despite.en: Despite the rain, the outdoor event continued as planned.
despite.zh: 儘管下雨，戶外活動仍照計畫進行。

destroy.en: A strong earthquake can destroy poorly built structures.
destroy.zh: 強烈地震可能摧毀結構不良的建築。

detail.en: Please include enough detail to make your explanation clear.
detail.zh: 請提供足夠細節，讓你的解釋更清楚。

detect.en: The new sensor can detect small changes in temperature.
detect.zh: 這個新感測器能偵測細微的溫度變化。

determine.en: The test will help determine which method is more effective.
determine.zh: 這項測試將幫助判斷哪種方法更有效。

develop.en: Students need time to develop strong reading habits.
develop.zh: 學生需要時間培養良好的閱讀習慣。

development.en: The report examines the development of public transportation in the city.
development.zh: 這份報告探討這座城市大眾運輸的發展。

device.en: This device measures air quality inside the classroom.
device.zh: 這個裝置用來測量教室內的空氣品質。

devote.en: She decided to devote more time to improving her writing.
devote.zh: 她決定投入更多時間提升寫作能力。

dialogue.en: The story uses dialogue to show the characters' different opinions.
dialogue.zh: 故事透過對話呈現角色不同的意見。

dictionary.en: Use a dictionary when the context does not reveal the word's meaning.
dictionary.zh: 當語境無法看出單字意思時，可以查字典。

die.en: Some plants die quickly if they receive too little sunlight.
die.zh: 有些植物若得到太少陽光會很快枯死。

diet.en: A balanced diet should include several different kinds of food.
diet.zh: 均衡飲食應包含多種不同食物。

differ.en: The two plans differ mainly in cost and schedule.
differ.zh: 這兩個方案主要在成本和時程上不同。

difference.en: The graph shows a clear difference between the two groups.
difference.zh: 這張圖表顯示兩組之間有明顯差異。

different.en: Different students may learn best in different ways.
different.zh: 不同學生最適合的學習方式可能不同。

difficult.en: The final question was difficult but not impossible to solve.
difficult.zh: 最後一題很難，但並不是無法解決。

difficulty.en: She had difficulty understanding the article without background knowledge.
difficulty.zh: 沒有背景知識時，她很難理解這篇文章。

digital.en: The school introduced digital textbooks in several classes this year.
digital.zh: 學校今年在幾個班級導入數位教科書。

dinner.en: We discussed the trip while eating dinner together.
dinner.zh: 我們一起吃晚餐時討論了這趟旅程。

direct.en: The teacher gave direct instructions before the experiment began.
direct.zh: 實驗開始前，老師給了明確直接的指示。

direction.en: The sign points in the direction of the train station.
direction.zh: 這個標誌指向火車站的方向。

director.en: The director explained the main idea behind the short film.
director.zh: 導演說明了這部短片背後的主要概念。

dirty.en: The water looked dirty after the heavy rain.
dirty.zh: 大雨過後，水看起來很髒。

disagree.en: Students may disagree while still respecting one another.
disagree.zh: 學生可以有不同意見，同時仍彼此尊重。

disappear.en: The clouds began to disappear as the weather improved.
disappear.zh: 天氣好轉時，雲開始散去。

disappoint.en: The canceled trip will disappoint many students who were excited about it.
disappoint.zh: 取消這趟旅行會讓許多期待已久的學生失望。

disaster.en: The town created a new emergency plan after the natural disaster.
disaster.zh: 這個城鎮在天然災害後制定了新的緊急應變計畫。

discipline.en: Regular practice requires patience and self-discipline.
discipline.zh: 規律練習需要耐心和自律。

discount.en: Students receive a discount when buying tickets with school identification.
discount.zh: 學生出示學生證購票可享折扣。

discover.en: Scientists may discover new patterns when they compare enough data.
discover.zh: 科學家比較足夠資料時可能發現新的模式。

discovery.en: The discovery led researchers to ask several new questions.
discovery.zh: 這項發現使研究人員提出了幾個新問題。

discuss.en: The class will discuss the article after everyone finishes reading it.
discuss.zh: 等大家讀完文章後，全班會一起討論。

discussion.en: The discussion became more useful after students began using evidence.
discussion.zh: 學生開始使用證據後，討論變得更有意義。

dish.en: This dish is made with rice, vegetables, and fresh fish.
dish.zh: 這道料理由米飯、蔬菜和新鮮魚類製成。

disk.en: The file was saved on an external disk for backup.
disk.zh: 這個檔案被儲存在外接磁碟中作為備份。

display.en: The screen will display your score after the quiz ends.
display.zh: 小考結束後，螢幕會顯示你的分數。

distance.en: The distance between the two stations is about five kilometers.
distance.zh: 兩個車站之間的距離約五公里。

distant.en: The mountain looked distant even though the sky was clear.
distant.zh: 即使天空晴朗，那座山看起來仍很遙遠。

distinguish.en: Students should learn to distinguish facts from personal opinions.
distinguish.zh: 學生應學會區分事實與個人意見。

distribute.en: The teacher will distribute the worksheets before the activity begins.
distribute.zh: 活動開始前，老師會發下學習單。

distribution.en: The chart shows the distribution of scores across the class.
distribution.zh: 這張圖表顯示全班分數的分布。

district.en: The school is located in a quiet residential district.
district.zh: 這所學校位於安靜的住宅區。

divide.en: Please divide the class into four equal groups.
divide.zh: 請把全班分成四個人數相同的小組。

doctor.en: The doctor advised him to rest and drink more water.
doctor.zh: 醫師建議他多休息並多喝水。

document.en: Please save the document before closing the program.
document.zh: 關閉程式前請先儲存文件。

dog.en: The dog waited quietly outside the store for its owner.
dog.zh: 那隻狗安靜地在店外等主人。

door.en: Please close the door quietly when you leave.
door.zh: 離開時請輕輕把門關上。

doubt.en: There is little doubt that regular practice improves performance.
doubt.zh: 規律練習能提升表現這件事幾乎沒有疑問。

down.en: Please write the key points down before the discussion ends.
down.zh: 討論結束前請把重點寫下來。

download.en: Students can download the worksheet from the class website.
download.zh: 學生可以從班級網站下載學習單。

dozen.en: The bakery prepared a dozen sandwiches for the school event.
dozen.zh: 麵包店為學校活動準備了十二個三明治。

draft.en: She wrote a first draft before revising her final essay.
draft.zh: 她先寫初稿，再修改成最後的文章。

drag.en: You can drag the file into the folder with the mouse.
drag.zh: 你可以用滑鼠把檔案拖進資料夾。

draw.en: Please draw a simple diagram to explain the process.
draw.zh: 請畫一個簡單圖示來說明這個過程。

dream.en: Her dream is to study marine biology in the future.
dream.zh: 她的夢想是未來學習海洋生物學。

dress.en: Students should dress appropriately for the formal ceremony.
dress.zh: 學生應為正式典禮穿著得體。

drink.en: Remember to drink enough water during long study sessions.
drink.zh: 長時間讀書時記得喝足夠的水。

drive.en: It takes about forty minutes to drive from here to the airport.
drive.zh: 從這裡開車到機場大約需要四十分鐘。

driver.en: The bus driver waited until every student was seated.
driver.zh: 公車司機等到每位學生都坐好才開車。

drop.en: The temperature may drop sharply after sunset in the mountains.
drop.zh: 山區日落後氣溫可能會快速下降。

dry.en: Keep the equipment in a dry place after cleaning it.
dry.zh: 清潔設備後請放在乾燥的地方。

due.en: The assignment is due at the end of next week.

during.en: Please remain quiet during the listening section of the test.
during.zh: 測驗聽力部分進行時請保持安靜。

dust.en: A thin layer of dust covered the unused bookshelf.
dust.zh: 沒使用的書架上覆著一層薄薄的灰塵。

duty.en: It is the monitor's duty to collect the worksheets after class.
duty.zh: 收學習單是班長下課後的職責。

dynamic.en: A dynamic classroom encourages students to ask questions and participate.
dynamic.zh: 有活力的課堂會鼓勵學生提問並參與。

economic.en: The report discusses several economic problems facing the country.
economic.zh: 這份報告討論該國面臨的幾項經濟問題。

environment.en: A quiet environment can make it easier to focus on studying.
environment.zh: 安靜的環境能讓人更容易專心讀書。

establish.en: The school hopes to establish a stronger reading culture among students.
establish.zh: 學校希望在學生之間建立更強的閱讀風氣。

estimate.en: We can estimate the total cost before making the final decision.
estimate.zh: 我們可以在做最後決定前估算總成本。

even.en: Even a short review can help you remember important ideas.
even.zh: 即使只是短暫複習，也能幫助你記住重要觀念。

evidence.en: The scientist looked for evidence before accepting the new explanation.
evidence.zh: 科學家在接受新的解釋前先尋找證據。

experience.en: Traveling alone gave him valuable experience in solving unexpected problems.
experience.zh: 獨自旅行讓他獲得處理突發問題的寶貴經驗。

factor.en: Sleep is an important factor in both health and learning.
factor.zh: 睡眠是影響健康與學習的重要因素。

feature.en: One useful feature of the app is its offline mode.
feature.zh: 這個應用程式的一項實用功能是離線模式。

find.en: You can find useful information on the library website.
find.zh: 你可以在圖書館網站上找到實用資訊。

function.en: This button has a useful function that saves your recent work.
function.zh: 這個按鈕有一項實用功能，可以儲存你最近的工作。

get.en: You will get better results if you review a little every day.
get.zh: 如果你每天複習一點，就會得到更好的成果。

go.en: We decided to go home before the weather became worse.
go.zh: 我們決定在天氣變差前先回家。

good.en: A good study plan should include both practice and rest.
good.zh: 好的讀書計畫應同時包含練習與休息。

however.en: The task looked difficult; however, we completed it on time.
however.zh: 這項任務看起來很困難；然而，我們仍準時完成了。

human.en: Human behavior can change when the environment changes suddenly.
human.zh: 當環境突然改變時，人類行為也可能跟著改變。

identify.en: Students should identify the main idea before reading the details.
identify.zh: 學生應先找出主旨，再閱讀細節。

impact.en: Social media can have a strong impact on how people receive news.
impact.zh: 社群媒體可能大幅影響人們接收新聞的方式。

indicate.en: The survey results indicate that students want more practice time.
indicate.zh: 調查結果顯示，學生希望有更多練習時間。

individual.en: Each individual may respond differently to the same situation.
individual.zh: 每個人對同一情況可能有不同反應。

information.en: The website provides useful information about scholarships and application deadlines.
information.zh: 這個網站提供有關獎學金與申請截止日期的實用資訊。

involve.en: The project will involve students from three different classes.
involve.zh: 這項專題將會有三個不同班級的學生參與。

issue.en: The class discussed an environmental issue that affects many cities.
issue.zh: 全班討論了一個影響許多城市的環境議題。

know.en: It is useful to know why an answer is correct.
know.zh: 知道一個答案為什麼正確是很有幫助的。

like.en: Many students like to review vocabulary before going to bed.
like.zh: 許多學生喜歡在睡前複習單字。

likely.en: Students who review regularly are more likely to remember new vocabulary.
likely.zh: 規律複習的學生更可能記住新單字。

maintain.en: It is easier to maintain a habit when you practice it regularly.
maintain.zh: 規律練習會讓維持一個習慣變得更容易。

major.en: Traffic is a major problem in many large cities.
major.zh: 交通是許多大城市的一項主要問題。

make.en: Small daily choices can make a big difference over time.
make.zh: 每天的小選擇久而久之可能帶來很大的改變。

mean.en: What does this sentence mean in the context of the passage?
mean.zh: 這個句子在文章語境中是什麼意思？

measure.en: The experiment used a digital scale to measure the amount of water.
measure.zh: 實驗使用電子秤測量水的量。

method.en: The teacher introduced a simple method for remembering difficult vocabulary.
method.zh: 老師介紹了一個記住困難單字的簡單方法。

new.en: The school introduced a new course on environmental science this year.
new.zh: 學校今年開設了一門新的環境科學課程。

occur.en: Mistakes often occur when people work too quickly without checking details.
occur.zh: 人們做事太快又沒有檢查細節時，常會發生錯誤。

often.en: Students often remember new words better when they use them in context.
often.zh: 學生在語境中使用新單字時，通常會記得更牢。

only.en: This ticket is only valid until the end of today.
only.zh: 這張票只有效到今天結束為止。

other.en: Some students prefer reading, while other students learn better by listening.
other.zh: 有些學生偏好閱讀，而其他學生用聽的學得更好。

out.en: We went out after class to buy something to eat.
out.zh: 下課後我們出去買了些東西吃。

participate.en: More students decided to participate in the school volunteer program.
participate.zh: 更多學生決定參加學校的志工計畫。

person.en: Every person in the group was asked to share one idea.
person.zh: 小組中的每個人都被要求分享一個想法。

potential.en: The new plan has the potential to improve student participation.
potential.zh: 這項新計畫有提升學生參與度的潛力。

principle.en: The teacher explained the basic principle behind the experiment.
principle.zh: 老師解釋了這項實驗背後的基本原理。

process.en: Learning a language is a gradual process that requires regular practice.
process.zh: 學習語言是一個需要規律練習的漸進過程。

reason.en: There is a clear reason why this method works better.
reason.zh: 這個方法為什麼效果更好有一個明確的原因。

relationship.en: The study examined the relationship between exercise and sleep quality.
relationship.zh: 這項研究探討運動與睡眠品質之間的關係。

require.en: This assignment will require careful reading and clear written explanations.
require.zh: 這份作業需要仔細閱讀以及清楚的書面說明。

research.en: The students conducted research on how sleep affects learning and memory.
research.zh: 學生研究睡眠如何影響學習與記憶。

resource.en: The library website is a useful resource for finding reliable information.
resource.zh: 圖書館網站是尋找可靠資訊的實用資源。

response.en: Her response showed that she had understood the question clearly.
response.zh: 她的回答顯示她已清楚理解這個問題。

responsibility.en: Students have a responsibility to complete their own work honestly.
responsibility.zh: 學生有責任誠實完成自己的作業。

result.en: The final result was better than we had expected.
result.zh: 最後的結果比我們原先預期的更好。

role.en: Parents can play an important role in supporting a student's learning.
role.zh: 家長可以在支持學生學習方面扮演重要角色。

section.en: Read the first section carefully before answering the questions below.
section.zh: 回答下方問題前，請先仔細閱讀第一部分。

see.en: You can see the difference clearly when the two charts are compared.
see.zh: 比較兩張圖表時，你可以清楚看出差異。

show.en: The results show that most students prefer shorter study sessions.
show.zh: 結果顯示，多數學生偏好較短的讀書時段。

significant.en: The experiment showed a significant improvement after the method was changed.
significant.zh: 方法改變後，實驗顯示出明顯的改善。

similar.en: The two experiments produced similar results under the same conditions.
similar.zh: 兩個實驗在相同條件下得到相似的結果。

situation.en: We need more information before we can understand the whole situation.
situation.zh: 我們需要更多資訊才能了解整個情況。

source.en: Always check whether a source is reliable before using its information.
source.zh: 使用資料前，務必先確認來源是否可靠。

specific.en: Please give a specific example to support your main point.
specific.zh: 請舉出一個具體例子來支持你的主要觀點。

standard.en: The final report must meet the standard required by the teacher.
standard.zh: 期末報告必須達到老師要求的標準。

strategy.en: She changed her study strategy after noticing which methods worked best.
strategy.zh: 她發現哪些方法最有效後，調整了自己的讀書策略。

structure.en: A clear structure makes an essay easier to read and understand.
structure.zh: 清楚的結構會讓文章更容易閱讀與理解。

suggest.en: The results suggest that regular practice improves long-term memory.
suggest.zh: 結果顯示，規律練習有助於提升長期記憶。

support.en: Good evidence can support an argument and make it more convincing.
support.zh: 良好的證據能支持論點，讓它更有說服力。

system.en: The school introduced a new system for borrowing library books.
system.zh: 學校導入了一套新的圖書借閱系統。

take.en: Please take a few minutes to check your answers again.
take.zh: 請花幾分鐘再檢查一次你的答案。

technology.en: New technology has changed the way people communicate across long distances.
technology.zh: 新科技已改變人們進行遠距溝通的方式。

theory.en: The experiment was designed to test whether the theory was correct.
theory.zh: 這個實驗是為了測試該理論是否正確。

there.en: There are several ways to solve this problem correctly.
there.zh: 有好幾種方法可以正確解決這個問題。

therefore.en: The road was closed; therefore, we had to take another route.
therefore.zh: 道路封閉了，因此我們只好改走另一條路。

time.en: We still have enough time to finish the project carefully.
time.zh: 我們還有足夠的時間仔細完成這個專題。

trend.en: The chart shows a clear trend toward greater online learning.
trend.zh: 這張圖表顯示線上學習增加的明顯趨勢。

use.en: Students can use this chart to compare the two results.
use.zh: 學生可以使用這張圖表比較兩個結果。

value.en: The teacher explained the value of checking evidence before making claims.
value.zh: 老師說明了提出主張前查證證據的重要性。

various.en: Students used various sources to complete their research project.
various.zh: 學生使用各種資料來源完成研究專題。

vary.en: Study methods may vary depending on the subject and the student.
vary.zh: 讀書方法可能因科目與學生而有所不同。

water.en: Remember to drink enough water during long study sessions.
water.zh: 長時間讀書時要記得喝足夠的水。

well.en: She explained the difficult idea so well that everyone understood it.
well.zh: 她把困難的觀念解釋得很好，因此大家都懂了。

while.en: I listened to music while I was cleaning my room.
while.zh: 我整理房間時一邊聽音樂。

work.en: Group projects work best when everyone has a clear role.
work.zh: 每個人都有明確分工時，小組專題最容易順利進行。

world.en: The internet allows people around the world to share information quickly.
world.zh: 網路讓世界各地的人能快速分享資訊。

year.en: Our school holds a science fair once every year.
year.zh: 我們學校每年舉辦一次科展。

amazing.en: The team made an amazing recovery after a difficult start.
amazing.zh: 這支隊伍在開局不利後出現驚人的逆轉。

anymore.en: We do not use that old computer anymore.
anymore.zh: 我們已經不再使用那台舊電腦了。

automatically.en: The app automatically saves your work every few minutes.
automatically.zh: 這個應用程式每隔幾分鐘會自動儲存你的工作。

autumn.en: The leaves begin to change color in early autumn.

classroom.en: The classroom became quiet as soon as the test began.
classroom.zh: 考試一開始，教室立刻安靜下來。

complicated.en: The instructions looked complicated until the teacher demonstrated each step.
complicated.zh: 在老師逐步示範前，這些說明看起來很複雜。

confused.en: I felt confused until the teacher explained the final step.
confused.zh: 直到老師解釋最後一步，我才不再感到困惑。

detailed.en: The guide gives detailed instructions for each step of the process.
detailed.zh: 這份指南提供每個步驟的詳細說明。
